k_provenance: Frozen Step 4A label-free median baseline partition count
reused_control: Step 4A reconstruction branch is the zero-clustering-loss control because it starts from the identical pretrained boundary, uses the same schedule and updates only reconstruction loss.

variant_definitions.no_pretraining: Original 36x36 network and map; zero autoencoder pretraining epochs before K-means and joint updates.
variant_definitions.kernel5: Original 36x36 network and channel widths; first encoder kernel changed from 15x15 to 5x5.
variant_definitions.half_capacity: Original 36x36 map and kernel sizes; encoder channels changed from 32/64/128 to 16/32/64 with symmetric decoder.
variant_definitions.map12_fixed36: A 12x12 cartographic layout is amplitude-adjusted and centered in a 36x36 tensor; the original 36x36 network and parameter count are retained.
variant_definitions.map24_fixed36: A 24x24 cartographic layout is amplitude-adjusted and centered in a 36x36 tensor; the original 36x36 network and parameter count are retained.

map_size_control: Input coordinates, selected-feature count, network input size, network parameters, latent size, K, optimizer and budgets remain fixed; only fitted cartographic grid density/topology changes. Amplitude is multiplied by 36^2/source_side^2 to match the original projection convention.
